data.name: Emilian
data.gender_notes: Emilian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘emulare’, meaning to rival or emulate. In Christianity, Emilian is a name associated with various saints and martyrs, particularly Emilian of Syracuse and Emilian of Rome. The name Emilian carries the meaning “Rival, Emulator” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Emilian usually hope their child will grow to embody rival, emulator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of dedication and rivalry with oneself to become better.
data.etymology: Emilian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rival, Emulator.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emilian total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Emilian carries a rich cultural heritage, particularly in the Christian tradition. It is a name associated with strong individuals who were known for their dedication to their faith, even in the face of adversity. Emilian of Syracuse, for instance, was a bishop who was martyred for refusing to abandon his Christian beliefs during a time of religious persecution. Emilian of Rome was a soldier who converted to Christianity and was eventually executed for his newfound faith. These stories of courage and sacrifice have become an important part of Christian history and have influenced the way we view and understand the name Emilian.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Emilian lies in its connection to emulation and imitation of Christ. The Latin root ‘emulare’ means to rival or emulate, and this concept can be applied to the Christian faith in the sense of striving to live a life that reflects the love, kindness, and self-sacrifice of Jesus. The stories of Saint Emilian and other martyred saints demonstrate the power of faith and the importance of remaining true to one's beliefs, even in difficult times. In this way, the name Emilian serves as a reminder to live a life of integrity and dedication to one's faith, and to emulate the example set by Christ.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Emilian: God's toil or labor; one devoted to God's service.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Emilian was a 5th century Roman emperor. The name Emilian carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Emilian was the last emperor of the Western Roman Empire before the fall of Rome in 476 AD.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Emilian remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Sarah Emilian in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Emilian, which means "Rival, Emulator". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
